The combat figure of a class is a card stage: frames[name] is a frame's art id, the rectangle (x, y, w, h) it is drawn in on the stage's canvas with the padding cancelled (the anchor is x 384 and the floor is y 480) and its body landmarks [headY, feetY, height] of the source raster; sequences[name] the poses of an action with their durations, the travel of the body and the impact index; unit is the height (canvas units) of the ready figure, which the figure box shows.
